      "observations": [
        "All two owned files and the complete 376-line diff were read. Preparation success and failure now dispatch one compose-prepare-message-completed event, with exception detail on failure. The observer uses a once listener for both outcomes, replacing separate success/failure listeners.",
        "The observer owns convertedData keyed by extension ID. It calls a conversion callback at most once per extension for the event and passes that value to the current result listener. Both after-send and after-save consumers return the same tab/details wrapper. Listener replacement therefore does not require data stored on the old listener object. The tracker supplies its live listener Set rather than a frozen snapshot.",
        "waitForOperationAndHandleResults awaits preparation before delivery. Its catch records the exception and resolves a potentially pending delivery promise; finally removes the folder, progress and send listeners. Result dispatch preserves mode filtering, optional exact outerWindowId filtering and ordered awaited callbacks. The command listener unregisters on success or failure.",
        "The existing accepted MV3 test starts four extensions, asserts sendNow and the full compose-details object, terminates backgrounds before the second send, checks primed listeners and then asserts the second event details. Its four direct assertions have non-empty expected-behavior messages containing should. It does not force listener replacement between conversion and completion or an early delivery failure. No test changes are included in this patch.",
        "The actual reviewed event itself is required; only event.detail is optional in event.detail?.exception. The source adopts that local distinction. The converted-result JSDoc is more precise than the property prose saying ComposeDetails: both selected callbacks actually return { tab, details }. If editing that prose, name the wrapper shape.",
        "Result handling nests conversion, operation outcome and window filtering. A small named result-delivery helper could make those roles clearer while preserving sequential awaits and exception propagation. This is a scoped readability suggestion, not an automatic refactor. The conversion callback has no local catch and the preparation wait has no local timeout; exceptional callback or missing-completion paths remain unexercised.",
        "Full Bug 2001549 and D273769 were read. The primary failure is listener.convertedData.get(...) being undefined in the MV3 send test. Human explanation distinguishes a stale failure listener, converted-data loss when listeners are replaced, and early delivery rejection before preparation completes. The source implements three corresponding changes rather than claiming one generic race cure.",
        "The complete own review has one actual inline, 1492117, saying the event itself cannot be null. The final source accesses event.detail?.exception without optional chaining on event, so adoption is checked directly. Updated diffs and remote completions follow approval; linked Try/log bodies were not opened. The author explicitly says they had not encountered preparation failing to resolve, which is not a universal completion guarantee."
